unit.why: A homily on written and oral Torah as the two pillars before a scholar's bier, illustrated by a legend about R. Moses Cordovero's funeral and the Ari, taken from Or ha-Yashar.
unit.boundary_note: Homiletic frame precedes the story within the same division.

stories.start_quote: וכך מצינו באיש קדוש מהרמ״ק ז״ל
stories.end_quote: והוציאו מביתו והנער הלך לו ע״כ
stories.summary_en: At the Ramak's funeral only a boy sees two pillars of fire before the bier. The Ari promises him his daughter in marriage, then perceives in the boy's face that he has had a seminal emission, tells him he has lost his high level and sends him away.

tags.why: Praises the Ramak and the Ari, pre-Hasidic kabbalists, in a tale cited from Or ha-Yashar
